critical_bugs: Unhandled exceptions from ET.parse() and file I/O will crash the agent if the input XML is missing, malformed, or inaccessible.
Type casting (int/float) on XML attributes lacks error handling; non-numeric or unexpected values trigger uncaught ValueError/TypeError.
warnings: Division by zero fallback returns 0 for normalized coordinates, which may silently corrupt downstream perception/navigation modules.
Uses print() statements instead of structured logging, hindering production debugging and monitoring.
No validation of CLI arguments (e.g., fps range, file existence, path traversal prevention).
recommendations: Wrap XML parsing and file operations in try/except blocks with appropriate error codes or graceful fallbacks.
Validate all CLI inputs before processing (check file existence, ensure fps > 0, sanitize/restrict paths to allowed directories).
Replace print() with Python's logging module for configurable verbosity and structured output.
Add data validation/sanitization for parsed annotations to prevent malformed JSONL generation.
